---
title: "Comparison_Resting_Membrane_Potential_Dual_Patch"
author: "Mirja grote Lambers"
date: "2026-05-30"
output: html_document
---

This script calculates the descriptive statistics (mean ± SEM, median, standard deviation, n) of the delta resting membrane potential (ΔVm) of patched pericyte-pericyte and pericyte-endothelial cell pairs in organotypic hippocampal slice cultures (OHSC) and acute human slice preparations. The normality of the distribution is tested using a Shapiro-Wilk test, a histogram, and a QQ plot. A nonparametric studentized permutation test for paired data (npar.t.test.paired, nparcomp; Konietschke & Pauly, 2012) was used to test whether the resting membrane potentials of the two cells in a pair differed systematically.

H0: The resting membrane potentials of the two patched cells do not differ systematically
     (relative effect p = 0.5)
H1: The resting membrane potentials of the two patched cells differ systematically
     (relative effect p ≠ 0.5)


library(nparcomp)

# load data
df_pp_human <- read.csv("Pericyte_Dual_Patch_Resting_MP_Human_Acute_Slices.csv")
df_ep_human <- read.csv("Endothelium_Pericyte_Dual_Patch_Resting_MP_Human_Acute_Slices.csv")
df_pp_ohsc  <- read.csv("Pericyte_Dual_Patch_Resting_MP.csv")
df_ep_ohsc  <- read.csv("Pericyte_Endothel_Pairs_Resting_MP.csv")

analyse_delta <- function(datasets) {
  for (name in names(datasets)) {
    df   <- datasets[[name]]
    data <- df$delta_resting
    n    <- length(data)
    sem  <- sd(data) / sqrt(n)
    sw   <- shapiro.test(data)

    df_long <- data.frame(
      Vm        = c(df$resting_channel_0, df$resting_channel_1),
      condition = factor(rep(c("ch0", "ch1"), each = n))
    )

    cat(sprintf("\n%s\n", name))
    cat(sprintf("n          = %d\n",             n))
    cat(sprintf("Mean ± SEM = %.2f ± %.2f mV\n", mean(data), sem))
    cat(sprintf("Median     = %.1f mV\n",         median(data)))
    cat(sprintf("SD         = %.2f mV\n",         sd(data)))
    cat(sprintf("Shapiro-Wilk : W = %.3f, p = %.3f\n", sw$statistic, sw$p.value))

    par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
    hist(data, freq = FALSE, breaks = 10, col = "steelblue", border = "white",
         main = paste(name, "— Histogram"), xlab = "ΔV_rest (mV)", ylab = "Density")
    qqnorm(data, main = paste(name, "— QQ-Plot"))
    qqline(data, col = "red")
    par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

    set.seed(42)
    np <- npar.t.test.paired(Vm ~ condition, data = df_long,
                            alternative = "two.sided",
                            info        = FALSE,
                            plot.simci  = FALSE)
    summary(np)
    plot(np)
  }
}

# Human Acute Slices
datasets_human <- list(
  "Pericyte-Pericyte" = df_pp_human,
  "Endothel-Pericyte" = df_ep_human
)
cat("\nHuman Acute Slices\n")
analyse_delta(datasets_human)

# OHSC
datasets_ohsc <- list(
  "Pericyte-Pericyte" = df_pp_ohsc,
  "Endothel-Pericyte" = df_ep_ohsc
)
cat("\nOHSC\n")
analyse_delta(datasets_ohsc)
